# Orbdra Networks

Orbdra Networks develops SurveyWing, an advanced drone survey platform designed specifically for civil engineering firms operating in construction site robotics. SurveyWing captures and processes aerial imagery to generate real-time 3D maps of construction sites, enabling builders to monitor progress, validate site plans, and optimize resource allocation efficiently.

SurveyWing’s key features include automated flight paths tailored for rebar tying verification, high-resolution orthomosaic generation, and seamless integration with existing project management software. This facilitates enhanced safety monitoring and reduces the need for manual site inspections.

Orbdra Networks completed over 450 aerial scans last quarter across multiple infrastructure projects, demonstrating strong early traction. The company recently closed a $6.5M Series A funding round led by Titan Ventures, fueling product development and market expansion.

The founding team combines expertise in robotics (led by CTO Dr. Lila Glimtun), drone systems (headed by COO Marcus Dorow), and civil engineering domain knowledge. Main competitors include SkyScape Robotics and BuildSight AI, both also targeting construction survey automation.

Open risks involve regulatory challenges with drone operations in urban zones, potential hardware integration issues, and the need to scale data processing infrastructure as client demand grows.
